book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: Fogg said: alive?
Sir Francis said: alive.
It is an old custom.
The widow is burned with her husband.

sentences.ar: والحكومة منعتها، بس بهالمناطق البعيدة، لسا بيعملوها.
sentences.en: And the government has banned it, but in these far regions, they still do it.

sentences.ar: قال الدليل: وهاي المرا ما بدها.
sentences.en: The guide said: and this woman does not want it.

sentences.ar: عطوها أفيون وحشيش عشان ما تقاوم.
sentences.en: They gave her opium and hemp so she would not resist.
And tomorrow at sunrise, they burn her.
The guide said: her name is Aouda.

sentences.ar: بنت تاجر غني من بومباي، ومتعلمة بمدارس إنجليزية.
sentences.en: The daughter of a rich Bombay merchant, educated in English schools.
And they married her by force to the old rajah.
And she fled, and they caught her.
And now, her husband has died.

sentences.ar: وأهله بدهم يحرقوها معه، عشان الورث.
sentences.en: And his family want to burn her with him, for the inheritance.
Fogg was silent.
And then said: we have twelve hours.
Sir Francis looked at him.
He said: twelve hours for what?
Fogg said: to save her.

sentences.ar: قال السير فرانسيس: إنت رجل إله قلب!
sentences.en: Sir Francis said: you are a man with a heart!
Fogg said: sometimes.
When I have time.

sentences.ar: وباسبارتو، فوق الفيل، سمع، وقلبه طار.
sentences.en: And Passepartout, on the elephant, heard, and his heart leapt.
And said: my master has a heart!
I knew it!
And the guide said: I am with you.
But it is dangerous.
Fogg said: I know.
And Sir Francis said: and I am with you.
And they waited for night.
